name: Pairwise Vector Similarity Self-Join with Coarse Cluster Pruning
description: Finding all similar document pairs across 100,000 docs is O(N^2) (10 billion checks). Partitioning into coarse category buckets first reduces search to O(N * (N/K)).
prompt:
Finding all similar document pairs across 100,000 docs is O(N^2) (10 billion checks). Partitioning into coarse category buckets first reduces search to O(N * (N/K)).

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: doc_a, doc_b, bucket_id, similarity.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Pairwise similarity evaluated ONLY within shared bucket partitions
            SELECT 
                a.doc_id AS doc_a,
                b.doc_id AS doc_b,
                a.bucket_id,
                ROUND(array_cosine_similarity(a.vector, b.vector), 4) AS similarity
            FROM corpus a
            JOIN corpus b
              ON a.bucket_id = b.bucket_id
             AND a.doc_id < b.doc_id
            WHERE array_cosine_similarity(a.vector, b.vector) >= 0.85
            ORDER BY similarity DESC;
why_it_fails: Unpartitioned cross joins cause out-of-memory crashes on analytical engines.
